Every R25GQ quarter route failed at CTS (-589/-1,633: one quarter-wide clock tree, 22 ICGs, 5,000-sink roots over 2,033x1,499 um). hfd_hc_tile_xl = closed ot_dsrom_su_hcpost_lane_pr (TT +155) + registered 162-b bc / 34-b capture / 256-b acc strip (30.24 um) + negedge root lockups; 135.648 x 156.33 (>= 20 um macro channel E/N/S, ~48 %), pins on the asap7 tracks, su tile PDN phase. Measured TT/FF peer-insertion IO budgets both launch phases, no IO false path. PD 0.55 HM 0.010.
